value.message: Oakville's Learn to Swim Preschool A, ages 3 to 5 with no parent in the water, runs Saturdays 9:00 to 9:30, Sept 12 to Nov 28, with Preschool B right after at 9:40 - their site says, and resident registration opens Tue Aug 11 at 7am. I could not pin down the price, but I'll keep watching and text you when I have it.
